title: Sheep wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- fluffy wool body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='22' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='50' r='12' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='50' r='12' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='65' r='11' fill='#e6e6e6'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='65' r='11' fill='#e6e6e6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='72' r='12' fill='#e6e6e6'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#d9b38c'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='38' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#c99a6b' transform='rotate(-20 33 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='38' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#c99a6b' transform='rotate(20 67 38)'/>
  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <rect x='37' y='33' width='12' height='9' rx='3' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <rect x='51' y='33' width='12' height='9' rx='3' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <rect x='49' y='35' width='2' height='2' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <line x1='37' y1='36' x2='30' y2='35' stroke='#2a2a3a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='63' y1='36' x2='70' y2='35' stroke='#2a2a3a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- lens shine -->
  <rect x='39' y='35' width='3' height='2' rx='1' fill='#8fd3ff'/>
  <rect x='53' y='35' width='3' height='2' rx='1' fill='#8fd3ff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 47 Q50 51 56 47' stroke='#8a5a3a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='41' y='78' width='5' height='10' rx='2' fill='#8a7a6a'/>
  <rect x='54' y='78' width='5' height='10' rx='2' fill='#8a7a6a'/>
</svg>
